controls.name: Data Aire dap4 / dap4 touch / Mini dap4 control alarms (Data Aire Series, Data Temp, gForce GT, gForce Ultra, Mini ceiling)
controls.description: Data Aire Alarm Processor 4 (about 2008 on; touch-screen dap4 touch about 2014 on). Alarm classes: Warning (*) = notification only; Urgent (**) = shuts down the affected function (compressor, fan, humidifier...); Critical (***) = complete unit shutdown. All alarms, including auto-reset ones, are logged in the History menu (last 100 alarms). Some alarm actions are configurable in Menu K (Alarms and Limits). The main status screen shows OFFbyALM when an alarm has shut the unit off.

diagnosticTips: Menus: F = Information, J = Factory Settings, K = Alarms and Limits.
High-pressure reset: press and hold SILENCE while the HP message is displayed.
Alarms scroll automatically and sound an audible alarm; only unacknowledged alarms keep sounding. Four programmable summary contacts are available for remote alarms.
EEV units: compare dap4 suction readings with gauges; more than 5 % difference means checking the EEV wiring and the EVD driver alarms.
Every Data Temp unit ships with dap4 control.

DAP III 'Warning and Alarms Displayed' list starts High Temperature Warning, High Humidity Warning, Low Temperature Warning, Low Humidity Warning, Low Pressure Compressor 1 (automatic reset) ... Firestat Temperature Alarm; the full list was not retrieved.
DAP-II units talk to a DART unit through a Data Alarm Network Module with network LEDs. FieldServer writes can push zeros into setpoints that were never set upstream (FS-8700-49 App. E.5).

commonIssues.symptom: Data Aire: High Pressure Compressor alarm, compressor will not restart
likelyCauses: Low water flow or fouled condenser (water-cooled)
HP lockout option active after repeated resets
checks: Fix the cause, then press and hold SILENCE while the HP message is displayed (manual reset)
Optional HP lockout after 2-5 resets per hour (auto-reset HP switch units): the compressor stays off until acknowledged
sources: dap4 User Manual (Data Aire) Alarms and Troubleshooting p.100 (read via search excerpts)
dap4 touch User Manual / IOM (Data Aire) (read via search excerpts)

commonIssues.symptom: Data Aire: Low Pressure Compressor alarm
likelyCauses: Low airflow over the evaporator / dirty filters
checks: Check airflow and filters
Check charge (gForce Ultra: add refrigerant if suction is below 50 psi)
Compare dap4 suction readings with gauges; >5 % difference = check EEV wiring and EVD alarms
sources: dap4 User Manual (Data Aire) Alarms and Troubleshooting p.100 (read via search excerpts)
gForce Ultra User Manual / IOM gFUltra_IOM 09/2020 (read via search excerpts)

commonIssues.symptom: Data Aire gForce Ultra: compressor called but does not start (Compressor VFD Alarm)
checks: Read the fault on the VFD display
Test with the Manual Override Module Cool 1 switch
sources: gForce Ultra User Manual / IOM gFUltra_IOM 09/2020 (read via search excerpts)
